reproducibility_gaps: No complete exact transitive dependency lock is provided across conda, pip, CPU-container and GPU-container routes.
Container recipes and tags are documented, but immutable image digests are not established in the pinned source.
The reusable library does not define one canonical paper/application dataset, experiment configuration, checkpoint or expected numeric result at resource scope.
Repository tests and container workflows were not executed under the Stage-3 static-only boundary.
notes: R2 is assigned at reusable-library scope: source, licensing, environment ranges, installation routes, CLI entrypoint, network/model interfaces, training workflow and evaluation tooling are statically recoverable.
R3 is not assigned because no single experiment/configuration is materialized for this general library and no exact end-to-end application contract is selected.
PiNN is Pair-wise Interaction Neural Network, not a physics-informed PDE PINN.
